actions: Apply the first half of the recommended nitrogen rate (e.g., 30 kg N ha⁻¹) using a calibrated spreader, preferably in the early morning to reduce volatilization.
Implement a mulch or cover‑crop strip on exposed soil areas to lower erosion risk and improve moisture retention.
Schedule the second half of the nitrogen dose in 10–14 days, timed with the next vegetative growth peak and after any significant rainfall has subsided.
Adjust irrigation to maintain field water levels just above field capacity, avoiding waterlogging that could exacerbate leaching.

Track rainfall events; if >20 mm occurs within 48 h of fertilizer application, consider delaying the second split to prevent runoff.
